chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamdani (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father, from Yahya ibn Abi Imran, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Sa'dan, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

«Alif Lam Meem» is a letter from the letters of the Great Name of Allah, the segmented [letters] in the Qur'an, which the Prophet (peace be upon him and his Family) and the Imam combine [into one], so if he supplicates with it, he is answered.
That Book, in which there is no doubt, a guidance to the godfearing
He said: It is a notice/clarification for our Shi'a.
Those who believe in the unseen, establish the prayer and from that which We sustained them, they spend.
He said: From that which we know, they inform, and from that which we taught them of the Qur'an, they recite.

key_terms.المقطع: Segmented (referring to the disjointed letters at the start of Qur'anic chapters)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the segmented letters (Alif Lam Meem) in the Qur'an according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s explanation that the disjointed letters (Huruful Muqatta'at), specifically Alif-Lam-Mim, constitute a fragment of the Divine Greatest Name (Ism al-A'zam), which the Prophet and Imams uniquely possess the authority to synthesize for answered supplication. This tradition underscores the Shia doctrine of the Imams' exclusive access to esoteric knowledge (Ilm al-Ghayb), linking their spiritual authority directly to the interpretation and recitation of the Qur'an as a source of guidance for the faithful.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Ahmad bin Ziyad bin Ja’far al-Hamdani, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya bin Abi Imran, from Yunus bin Abdul-Rahman, from Sa’dan, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

«Alif Laam Meem» is a letter from the letters of the Great Name of Allah that is segmented in the Qur’an, which is known by the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, and the Imam by which if he supplicates, he will be answered.
«That Book, in which there is no doubt, a guidance to the godfearing» [2:2].
He said: It is a notice to our Shi’a.
«Those who believe in the unseen, establish the prayer and from that which We sustained them, they spend.» [2:3]
He said: From that which we know, they inform, and from that which we taught them of the Qur’an, they recite.
